parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the bucket is a curved plastic rod attached to the upper sides of the bucket, designed for carrying.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, distributing the weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can rotate or pivot around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing flexible movement during carrying.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical container of the bucket made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds liquids or solids, providing the main storage capacity of the bucket.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a fixed, rigid structure that does not move independently; it supports the handle and contents.
